title: Chapter 454: The Grand Finale
content:
Chapter 454: The Grand Finale

After Zhong Yuxiu broke through to the seventh level, he immediately fought south and north, and in just half a year, he unified the entire southern part of the Liao Zhai world.

With the integration of the entire south, Zhong Yu's imperial power experienced another round of skyrocketing.

Especially now that the other four major empires in the mainland are desperately fighting internally, and all countries are slowly consuming their foundations due to wars, and their strength is constantly declining.

Zhong Yu overwhelmed all the gods in the south with his powerful strength, and was able to completely unify the south to establish an unprecedented great empire, which is so dazzling in the entire history of the Liao Zhai world.

With such an obvious contrast, countless angels in the field, as long as they have the desire for power, or other ideas of unifying the world and creating peace, all choose to join the camp of Yuguo.

In addition to the heavenly immortals, there are also more sixth- and seventh-tier powerhouses with more desires and more political ambitions to join.

The addition of these people has greatly expanded the power of Yuguo, making the number of Yuguo angels break through 20 at once.

And really established an army composed entirely of powerhouses of the sixth and seventh ranks, with a total of 1,000 people in this army. Although it is small, even an ordinary army of hundreds of millions can cause far less damage than this mere thousand people.

In fact, in addition to the increase of these external forces, Zhong Yu's own strength has also been greatly increased.

Because of the large-scale expansion of the imperial country's territory, it has more than doubled. Therefore, Zhong Yu had just broken through to the eighth-level cultivation base, but his luck also increased greatly due to the expansion of the territory. extremely.

With this level of cultivation, coupled with Zhong Yu's invincible combat power within the same rank, basically there is no fairy in this world, and it is no longer a distant dream to be his opponent with one against a hundred.

Zhong Yu is extremely convinced that as long as he can reach the peak of the eighth order, then he can definitely defeat a hundred with one. At that time, relying on his own strength, he will be able to suppress the entire Liaozhai world, making countless arrogant and ambitious people dare not stand out.

However, even if one can't fight against a hundred now, Zhong Yu can still deal with thirty or forty people of the same rank by himself.

Coupled with the celestial beings who have reached the 27th place in the imperial country, the overall strength of the whole country at the top has reached more than 50th. Although it is a bit delusional to crush the world, it is not false to be invincible.

The human race in this world originally had more than two hundred heavenly immortals, but in recent years, disputes between countries in the world have broken out frequently.

And all the gods, when they fight, are not as close as they used to be. They don't just aim to win or lose, but to decide life and death as their sole goal. They attack extremely fiercely and do whatever they can to achieve their goals.

So after this round of consumption, not only the people at the bottom suffered, but the total population of the human race in the whole world was reduced by one-fifth. Even the number of celestial beings has dropped to over a hundred, barely half of the original number.

Of the remaining celestial beings, Yuguo accounted for a full 1/5. Coupled with Zhong Yu's terrifying and abnormal combat power, the celestial level's combat power was already enough to compete with the entire human race without falling behind.

Not to mention the human race, now that there are so many conflicts, it is impossible to unite with each other, and it is even more impossible to resist the imperial kingdom that concentrates all its forces.

After integrating the south, Zhong Yu stepped up time to train the army. His overall goal was to train an elite regular army with a scale of 100 million.

Although these low-level soldiers have no vital influence on the true belonging of the world. However, when Zhong Yu lays down a piece of land, some low-level personnel are always needed to maintain law and order and rule.

There is only one person in Zhong Yu Zaiqiang, if he doesn't want to kill all the enemies on the site and snatch an open space. Then you must arrange for your trustworthy personnel to take over, make reasonable use of this land, and provide a steady stream of power for the development of Yuguo.

Therefore, after the imperial kingdom unified the southern region, it fell into a long period of recuperation. The entire south also ushered in real peace because of this recuperation. Because this land does not have several owners like before, there is only one owner who can make a sound here, and that is Zhong Yu.

Five years later, there are still constant disputes all over the world, although some places have won the victory due to the competition for interests, and slowly began to restore calm.

But also because of the more tragic battle, the strength was depleted even more seriously.

When all countries in the world are exhausted from the long war and can no longer sustain themselves, they have to hide in the dark to lick their wounds and wait for the day when their strength recovers to decide the outcome again.

Because of several years of recuperation, Zhong Yu finally accumulated enough troops and talents to take over all the lands in the world, so he personally led all the celestial masters in the country to go out and start the journey of fighting in all directions.

The target this time is the north which is closest to the imperial country.

After these years of wars, the northern countries have long lost their strength. Although some victors have made up for it by annexing the losers, they are still insignificant compared to the overall strength.

In particular, the Han Empire, the original northern overlord, was completely destroyed under the siege of the seven surrounding countries. All the royal families in the country, from heavenly immortals to ordinary people, were all slaughtered by those enemies, and there was absolutely no chance of recovery.

And the last two remaining empires, because of the sudden expansion of their territory several times, couldn't digest it at all, and fell into internal conflicts, unable to extricate themselves.

This time Zhong Yu personally led more than 20 angels to the north, and the remaining three angels in the north could not stop them at all. The moment Zhong Yu arrived at the city, he decisively led the whole country to surrender, not even daring to resist a little.

In this way, in less than ten days, the whole north completely changed its flag and merged into the Yu Kingdom.

It took more than a month, and with the arrival of Yu Kingdom's 20 million troops, the riots in the entire northern region were completely stabilized, and they were really controlled by Zhong Yu.

After conquering the north, Zhong Yu did not stop, but turned his attention to the state of Zhou in the middle.

When all countries in the world are in chaos, China, which is located in the center of the world, should have become the center of war, but because of Zhou Guo's political system, it has become the most peaceful area.

Compared with other countries, China's political system is extremely different, and it still maintains the customs of ancient times, adopting the enfeoffment system. For other countries, it does not mean that they must perish, but requires all countries to submit to it, then Zhou Guo will not attack.

Under this special system, except for a few empires that were ambitious and unwilling to surrender, most of the countries in the central region had invested in Zhou Guo's command.
